independence_policy: Authoritative employer PDFs, employer ATS pages, or Government of Canada Job Bank posting snapshots were labeled before comparison. JobSpy/provider fields were not used as ground truth.
sample_policy: The explicit-pay sample contains 20 unique postings: 10 ECE and 10 software. The no-pay sample contains 10 unique authoritative ATS/employer snapshots where no compensation statement was present in the checked content. 'Not specified' means not stated in that checked posting, not that compensation never exists.

salary_exact.comparison: annualized minimum, annualized maximum, cadence, and currency

salary_unspecified.comparison: authoritative checked content stated no compensation; parser returned missing/not stated

experience_ece_inclusive.comparison: required numeric range, required credential-only, or explicitly unspecified

location_and_arrangement.comparison: authoritative city/region and on-site, hybrid, or remote label

professional_credentials.comparison: ECE registration/diploma/first aid or software role credential statements were retained as evidence; no credential was invented

salary_parser_run.details: parse_salary_text compared annualized minimum, maximum, cadence, and currency against every explicit-pay label

unspecified_salary_parser_run.details: parse_salary_text returned missing/not stated for each authoritative no-pay snapshot

experience_parser_run.details: analyze_job_seniority compared each labeled experience snippet, including numeric, credential-only, and unspecified cases

location_normalization_run.details: jobspy_result_to_job_payload and normalize_job_payload retained each authoritative location and arrangement label

confirmed_defects_fixed: Decimal/range salary endpoints were previously collapsed to the minimum.
Legitimate annual ranges above CAD 350,000 were previously rejected as implausible.
Experience snippets using 'years building/shipping/working' were previously under-recognized.
